audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart (phases[].side) says Lux wins Levels 1-3 and Skill 4-6/1st item, while the content-layer chart (win[]) says Skill 1-3 and Lux 4-6/1st item. The two layers directly contradict each other on who wins each stage.
audit.why: Content's whys[] give kit-grounded reasoning matching its own win[] array (Lux's Q root has a long ~10-11s cooldown that creates real punish windows early, but her Q-E poke and Final Spark out-range Sona once items land). Full's phases[].why are generic templates with no matching reasoning, so content is the more trustworthy layer.
audit.corrected: Align full phases[].side to content win[]: Skill, Skill, Skill, Lux, Lux, Lux, Sona.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers in it at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: The field exists specifically to give real cooldown numbers players can play around.
audit.corrected: Cite Sona's R (100/120/140s inverse, i.e. 140-100s) and Lux's Q (10s) cooldowns directly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lux's Q (Light Binding) is a 10s-cooldown double-root and her Q/W/E/R are all projectiles blockable by Wind Wall-class effects, but nothing in the page states the actual cooldown number, and dosFull/dontsFull bullets were copy-pasted from tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles instead of explaining the named interaction.
audit.why: A player reading 'Bank Q for the real window' should learn WHEN Lux's root is down, not re-read the generic trade blurb.
audit.corrected: Write dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d to actually match their titles, and fold Light Binding's cooldown into breakdown.cooldowns.
